portal_hypertension.title: Hepatic sarcoidosis presenting with portal hypertension without histologically established cirrhosis and reticular hepatic imaging features.
portal_hypertension.authors: Yamamoto K, Itoh S, Sahara K
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：我们报告了一名 50 岁男性，在手术期间偶然在肝脏表面发现非干酪样肉芽肿后，他被转诊进行疑似肝结节病评估。 临床提示：实验室检查显示胆汁淤积模式，伴有碱性磷酸酶和 γ-谷氨酰转肽酶升高、轻度血小板减少、血管紧张素转换酶和可溶性白细胞介素 2 受体升高
portal_hypertension.abstract: We report a 50-year-old man who was referred for evaluation of suspected hepatic sarcoidosis after non-caseating granulomas were incidentally identified on the liver surface during surgery. Laboratory tests showed a cholestatic pattern with elevated alkaline phosphatase and gamma-glutamyl transpeptidase, mild thrombocytopenia, and increased angiotensin-converting enzyme and soluble interleukin-2 receptor levels. Contrast-enhanced computed tomography demonstrated marked surface irregularity and reticular hypoattenuated linear structures within the liver. portal_hypertension.title: Early-onset severe sinusoidal obstruction syndrome following adjuvant CAPOX: clinicoradiological diagnosis and favourable outcome after treatment with defibrotide.
portal_hypertension.authors: Soldado-Serrano A, Zamorano-García E, Alarcón-Blanco PA
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：肝窦阻塞综合征 (SOS) 是一种罕见的肝血管并发症，通常与造血干细胞移植相关，但也可能发生在基于奥沙利铂的化疗后。 临床提示：我们报道了一名患有 III 期结肠腺癌的 52 岁女性患者，接受 CAPOX 辅助治疗后三周出现黄疸、腹水、体重快速增加、血小板减少和严重肝功能障碍
portal_hypertension.abstract: Sinusoidal obstruction syndrome (SOS) is an uncommon hepatic vascular complication classically associated with haematopoietic stem cell transplantation, although it may also occur following oxaliplatin-based chemotherapy. We report the case of a 52-year-old woman with stage III colon adenocarcinoma treated with adjuvant CAPOX who developed jaundice, ascites, rapid weight gain, thrombocytopenia, and severe liver dysfunction three weeks after completing chemotherapy. After other causes of acute liver injury had been excluded, Doppler ultrasound demonstrated reversal of portal venous flow and signs of portal hypertension consistent with SOS. portal_hypertension.title: Esophagogastric intramural hematoma mimicking varices and a gastric fundal mass.
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：食管胃壁内血肿很少见，可能类似于静脉曲张或上消化道肿瘤。 临床提示：我们报告了一名血流动力学稳定的患者，接受长期阿司匹林治疗，在转诊医院进行胃镜检查和结肠镜检查后出现黑便。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Esophagogastric intramural hematoma is rare and may mimic varices or an upper gastrointestinal neoplasm. We report a hemodynamically stable patient receiving long-term aspirin therapy who developed melena after gastroscopy and colonoscopy at a referring hospital. Contrast-enhanced computed tomography showed a continuous hyperattenuating mural lesion extending approximately 16 cm from the distal esophagus across the esophagogastric junction into the cardia and gastric fundus, with a 3.8 × 2.6 cm mass-like fundal component and no active contrast extravasation, perforation or radiological evidence of portal hypertension.
